Use predictive modeling to increase and optimize customer experiences, revenue generation, ad targeting, and other business outcomes.

Process, cleanse, and verify the integrity of data used for analysis.
Conduct advanced data analysis and complex designs algorithm.
Work on data mining, data science, and data visualization projects.

Strong problem-solving skills with an emphasis on product development.

Great communication skills.

Proficiency in using query languages such as SQL, Hive, Pig (experience with NoSQL databases, such as MongoDB, Cassandra, HBase is a plus).
Experience with cloud services: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud (is a plus).
3+ Years of experience as a Data Scientist or Data Analyst.
Proven experience in data mining.
Demonstrated ability to build solutions for a diverse range of business problems.
Analytical-minded and detail-oriented, with a passion for analyzing and deriving meaningful insights from data.
Independent and capable of working in a fully remote setting while managing your time effectively.

As a Data Scientist, you will analyze large amounts of raw information to find patterns that will help improve our company and our clients' business strategies. Your primary focus will be in applying data mining techniques, conducting statistical analysis, and building high-quality prediction systems integrated with our products.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop custom data models and algorithms to apply to data sets.
Use predictive modeling to increase and optimize customer experiences, revenue generation, ad targeting, and other business outcomes.
Develop company A/B testing framework and test model quality.
Coordinate with different functional teams to implement models and monitor outcomes.
Process, cleanse, and verify the integrity of data used for analysis.
Conduct advanced data analysis and complex designs algorithm.
Work on data mining, data science, and data visualization projects.
cond_0128.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
3+ Years of demonstrated expertise as a Data Scientist or Data Analyst.
Proven track record in data mining.
Strong command of statistical computer languages (R, Python, SQL, etc.) to manipulate data and draw insights from large data sets.
Advanced knowledge of machine learning techniques (clustering, decision tree learning, artificial neural networks, etc.) and their real-world advantages and drawbacks.
Deep knowledge of advanced statistical techniques and concepts (regression, properties of distributions, statistical tests, and proper usage, etc.) and their applications.
Extensive expertise in machine learning techniques and algorithms.
Strong problem-solving skills with an emphasis on product development.
Demonstrated ability to build solutions for a diverse range of business problems.
Exceptional communication skills.
Preferred Requirements:
Deep knowledge of common data science toolkits, such as R, Weka, NumPy, MatLab, etc.; expertise in at least one of these is strongly preferred.
Proficiency in data visualization tools, such as D3.js, GGplot, etc.
Strong command of query languages such as SQL, Hive, Pig; solid understanding of NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, Cassandra, or HBase is a plus.
Proficiency in cloud services: AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

Your primary focus will be applying data mining techniques, conducting statistical analysis, and building high-quality prediction systems integrated with our products.
cond_0249.responsibilities:
Develop custom data models and algorithms to apply to data sets.
Use predictive modeling to increase and optimize customer experiences, revenue generation, ad targeting, and other business outcomes.
Develop company A/B testing framework and test model quality.
Stay in close contact with different functional teams to implement models, clarify requirements, and monitor outcomes.
Process, cleanse, and verify the integrity of data used for analysis.
Conduct advanced data analysis and complex algorithm design.
Work on data mining, data science, and data visualization projects, communicating findings clearly to relevant stakeholders.
cond_0249.requirements:
Strong problem-solving skills with an emphasis on product development.
Experience using statistical computer languages (R, Python, SQL, etc.) to manipulate data and draw insights from large data sets.
Knowledge of a variety of machine learning techniques (clustering, decision tree learning, artificial neural networks, etc.) and their real-world advantages/drawbacks.
Experience with advanced statistical techniques and concepts (regression, properties of distributions, statistical tests, and proper usage, etc.) and experience with applications.
Excellent understanding of machine learning techniques and algorithms.
Experience with common data science toolkits, such as R, Weka, NumPy, MatLab, etc. Excellence in at least one of these is highly desirable.
Great communication skills, including the ability to explain trade-offs and walk others through findings clearly.
Experience with data visualization tools, such as D3.js, GGplot, etc.
Proficiency in using query languages such as SQL, Hive, Pig. Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, Cassandra, HBase is a plus.
Experience with cloud services: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud is a plus.
3+ Years of experience as a Data Scientist or Data Analyst.
Proven experience in data mining.
Demonstrated ability to build solutions for a diverse range of business problems.
Analytical-minded and detail-oriented, with an interest in deriving meaningful insights from data.
Able to manage your time effectively and work independently.
Willing to learn and adapt to new technologies and challenges in the data science field.
Able to translate complex findings into clear insights and actionable strategies.

In this role, you will regularly work with different functional teams to analyze large amounts of raw information, find patterns, and help improve business strategies. Your primary focus will be applying data mining techniques, conducting statistical analysis, and building high-quality prediction systems integrated with our products.
cond_0321.responsibilities:
Develop custom data models and algorithms to apply to data sets.
Use predictive modeling to increase and optimize customer experiences, revenue generation, ad targeting, and other business outcomes.
Develop company A/B testing framework and test model quality.
Stay in close contact with different functional teams to implement models, clarify requirements, and monitor outcomes.
Process, cleanse, and verify the integrity of data used for analysis.
Conduct advanced data analysis and complex algorithm design.
Work on data mining, data science, and data visualization projects, communicating findings clearly to relevant stakeholders.
cond_0321.requirements:
Strong problem-solving skills with an emphasis on product development.
Experience using statistical computer languages (R, Python, SQL, etc.) to manipulate data and draw insights from large data sets.
Knowledge of a variety of machine learning techniques (clustering, decision tree learning, artificial neural networks, etc.) and their real-world advantages/drawbacks.
Experience with advanced statistical techniques and concepts (regression, properties of distributions, statistical tests, and proper usage, etc.) and experience with applications.
Excellent understanding of machine learning techniques and algorithms.
Experience with common data science toolkits, such as R, Weka, NumPy, MatLab, etc. Excellence in at least one of these is highly desirable.
Great communication skills, including the ability to explain trade-offs and walk others through findings clearly.
Experience with data visualization tools, such as D3.js, GGplot, etc.
Proficiency in using query languages such as SQL, Hive, Pig. Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, Cassandra, HBase is a plus.
Experience with cloud services: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud is a plus.
3+ Years of experience as a Data Scientist or Data Analyst.
Proven experience in data mining.
Demonstrated ability to build solutions for a diverse range of business problems.
Analytical-minded and detail-oriented, with an interest in deriving meaningful insights from data.
Able to manage your time effectively and work independently.
Willing to learn and adapt to new technologies and challenges in the data science field.
Able to translate complex findings into clear insights and actionable strategies.
cond_0321.values: We value excellence and take pride in delivering strong results. We aim to hold a high standard in our work and in the outcomes we create.
cond_0321.workplace_support: We believe growth happens in supportive environments, not in isolation. Through mentorship, collaboration, and shared accountability, we create space for employees to learn, contribute, and succeed.

Develop custom data models and algorithms to apply to data sets.
Use predictive modeling to increase and optimize customer experiences, revenue generation, ad targeting, and other business outcomes.
Develop company A/B testing framework and test model quality.
Coordinate with different functional teams to implement models and monitor outcomes.
Process, cleanse, and verify the integrity of data used for analysis.
Conduct advanced data analysis and complex designs algorithm.
Work on data mining, data science, and data visualization projects.
cond_0516.requirements:
Strong problem-solving skills with an emphasis on product development.
Experience using statistical computer languages (R, Python, SLQ, etc.) to manipulate data and draw insights from large data sets.
Familiarity with a variety of machine learning techniques (clustering, decision tree learning, artificial neural networks, etc.) and their real-world advantages/drawbacks.
Background in advanced statistical techniques and concepts (regression, properties of distributions, statistical tests, and proper usage, etc.) and experience with applications.
Working knowledge of machine learning techniques and algorithms.
Experience with common data science toolkits, such as R, Weka, NumPy, MatLab, etc. Comfort with at least one of these is highly desirable.
Ability to communicate effectively.
Experience with data visualization tools, such as D3.js, GGplot, etc.
Experience with query languages such as SQL, Hive, Pig (experience with NoSQL databases, such as MongoDB, Cassandra, HBase is a plus).
Exposure to cloud services: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud (is a plus).
Around 3 years of experience as a Data Scientist or Data Analyst, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience in data mining.
Experience building solutions for a range of business problems.

The primary focus is applying data mining techniques, conducting statistical analysis, and building prediction systems integrated with our products.
cond_0619.responsibilities:
Develop custom data models and algorithms to apply to data sets.
Use predictive modeling to optimize customer experiences, revenue generation, ad targeting, and other business outcomes.
Develop and maintain an A/B testing framework and test model quality.
Coordinate with relevant functional teams to implement models and monitor outcomes.
Process, cleanse, and verify the integrity of data used for analysis.
Conduct advanced data analysis and design complex algorithms.
Work on data mining, data science, and data visualization projects.
cond_0619.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
3+ Years of experience as a Data Scientist or Data Analyst.
Proven experience in data mining.
Experience using statistical computer languages (R, Python, SQL, etc.) to manipulate data and draw insights from large data sets.
Knowledge of machine learning techniques (clustering, decision tree learning, artificial neural networks, etc.) and their real-world advantages and drawbacks.
Experience with advanced statistical techniques and concepts (regression, properties of distributions, statistical tests, and proper usage, etc.).
Strong problem-solving skills with an emphasis on product development.
Demonstrated ability to build solutions for a range of business problems.
Clear written communication and direct verbal reporting.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with common data science toolkits such as R, Weka, NumPy, MatLab, etc. Proficiency in at least one of these is a plus.
Experience with data visualization tools such as D3.js, GGplot, etc.
Proficiency in query languages such as SQL, Hive, Pig; experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, Cassandra, or HBase is a plus.
Experience with cloud services: AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Ability to work independently in a remote setting while managing time effectively.
Ability to translate complex findings into clear, actionable insights.
cond_0619.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

Your primary focus will be applying data mining techniques, conducting statistical analysis, and building high-quality prediction systems integrated with our products. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic behind data patterns and statistical methods.
cond_0634.responsibilities:
Develop custom data models and algorithms to apply to data sets.
Use predictive modeling to increase and optimize customer experiences, revenue generation, ad targeting, and other business outcomes.
Develop company A/B testing framework and test model quality.
Coordinate with different functional teams to implement models and monitor outcomes.
Process, cleanse, and verify the integrity of data used for analysis.
Conduct advanced data analysis and complex designs algorithm.
Work on data mining, data science, and data visualization projects.
cond_0634.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
3+ Years of experience as a Data Scientist or Data Analyst.
Proven experience in data mining.
Experience using statistical computer languages (R, Python, SLQ, etc.) to manipulate data and draw insights from large data sets.
Knowledge of a variety of machine learning techniques (clustering, decision tree learning, artificial neural networks, etc.) and their real-world advantages/drawbacks.
Experience with advanced statistical techniques and concepts (regression, properties of distributions, statistical tests, and proper usage, etc.) and experience with applications.
Excellent understanding of machine learning techniques and algorithms.
Strong problem-solving skills with an emphasis on product development.
Great communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to build solutions for a diverse range of business problems.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with common data science toolkits, such as R, Weka, NumPy, MatLab, etc. Excellence in at least one of these is highly desirable.
Experience with data visualization tools, such as D3.js, GGplot, etc.
Proficiency in using query languages such as SQL, Hive, Pig. Experience with NoSQL databases, such as MongoDB, Cassandra, HBase is a plus.
Experience with cloud services: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud is a plus.
